recentItems.title: Bad weather dampens Thanksgiving plans
recentItems.description:
The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed until Saturday due to severe weather conditions Thursday. Meanwhile, it's snowing in the Midwest and there are flood warnings on both coasts. Rob Marciano reports.

recentItems.title: Testing continues after Iowa detonation, no lead detected in air hours after, EPA says
recentItems.description:
No lead has been detected in the air near the Army's controlled blast site in Iowa, where they detonated nearly five tons of lead explosives on Wednesday, according to the Environmental Protection Agency. Some locals remain concerned. Ian Lee reports.
